vuln.name: HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) Policy Not Enabled
vuln.description: HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) tells a browser that a web site is only accessable using HTTPS. It was detected that your web application doesn't implement HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) as the Strict Transport Security header is missing from the response.
vuln.impact: HSTS can be used to prevent and/or mitigate some types of man-in-the-middle (MitM) attacks
vuln.recommendation: It's recommended to implement HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) into your web application. Consult web references for more information
